summary: Female snowmobiler with a back injury near Halfmoon Campground (Mt. of the Holy Cross Wilderness, outside Minturn); transported by VMRG snowmobile team and Eagle County paramedics to an ambulance at the base of Tigiwon Road; out ~8 p.m.
location: Halfmoon Campground, Mt. of the Holy Cross Wilderness
